verdict.rationale: cubic lets teams define their own review rules (custom agents, configured in cubic.yaml), and these run automatically when PRs are opened. It also offers automatic actions such as policy-gated auto-approval and automatic thread resolution. These are fixed, PR-scoped behaviors, not a general event-to-action rule engine. missing for 10: user-definable event triggers beyond PR review, configurable custom actions per rule, documented conditional rule logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Custom agents are review rules that enforce your organization's specific best practices across pull requests.
`cubic.yaml` lives in the root of your repository and becomes the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, and custom agents.
Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
cubic can approve clean pull requests automatically when your repository policy allows it.
Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
